name: Smoked Salmon Bowl with Ginger Rice, Edamame, Mango & Avocado

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish
1 ½ mangoes
3 avocados

instructions.primary_message: Peel and grate or mince the ginger.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add ginger, water, and salt; bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce the heat to low. Cook the rice until the liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove the rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place edamame in the colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain.
Combine vinegar, sesame seeds, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl; whisk to dissolve the sugar.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp sesame seeds
1 tbsp brown sugar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Trim cucumbers and thinly slice crosswise into rounds. Add to the bowl with the vinegar mixture.
Trim off and discard tops and root ends of radishes; thinly slice and add to the bowl with the cucumber. Stir to combine the salad.
Peel mangos and slice flesh away from the pit, starting with the flat sides. Medium dice and set aside.
Combine chili-garlic sauce and mayonnaise in a small bowl; whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp chili-garlic sauce
⅓ cup mayonnaise

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin, then scoop out, keeping avocado halves intact. Fill avocado halves with spicy mayo.
Divide rice, edamame, mango, and cucumber-radish salad between bowls; top with smoked salmon and an avocado half. Serve with soy sauce on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (113 g) pkg smoked salmon
2 tbsp soy sauce
